name: Holy Conquest halves the mana cost of Paragon, Chosen of the Light and Judgement Day (#865)
contract: Holy Conquest 504248 is family 33, Attributes 448 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE), EquippedItemClass -1, no Stances, so it self-applies on learn. Its single effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) with EffectMiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) and EffectSpellClassMask word0 4104 (bits 0x8 and 0x1000), word2 8388608 (bit 0x800000), EffectBasePoints -51 + DieSides 1 = -50. Judgement Day 806121 carries SpellFamilyFlags word0 8; Chosen of the Light 800622 carries word0 4096; Paragon 680639 carries word2 8388608 (also relied on by AscensionSunClericBattleCleric.cpp's own 'Paragon only' cooldown mask). SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost calls ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_COST, ...) unconditionally for every spell, native and generic; this is not "no server-side implementation", the mana-cost reduction already applies to exactly the three named spells. spell_power_cost queries CalcPowerCost directly with no cast submitted.
